commands.name: flowleap:patstat-portfolio-analysis (MCP)
commands.description: Resolve an applicant to one harmonized entity and present its patent portfolio with the right caveats.

commands.name: flowleap:patstat-guarded-sql (MCP)
commands.description: Answer an aggregate patent question with agent-written SQL through `patstat_query` (CLI: `flowleap patstat query "<sql>" --question "<question>"`) under the deterministic gate — the one-retry loop. You own the retry: errors carry the exact parser/Postgres detail, fix once, never loop (the 10/min budget is the bound).

commands.name: flowleap:patstat-graph (MCP)
commands.description: Answer "named node and its relationships" questions — citations, family, applicants/inventors, or the path between two patents — with the resolve-first flow: resolve free-form input to an anchor/psn_id once with `patstat_resolve` (CLI: `flowleap patstat graph resolve <input>`), then call the graph tool that matches the question.

content.text:
Siemens AG filed 32,497 applications from 2016 through 2025 across 49 offices, per PATSTAT 2026 Spring. The table below shows filings by filing year for the top offices. "Other" bundles the remaining 41 offices.

| Year | EP | WO | US | CN | DE | KR | CA | BR | Other | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2016 | 1,150 | 1,066 | 817 | 538 | 907 | 102 | 54 | 79 | 485 | 5,198 |
| 2017 | 1,190 | 1,217 | 671 | 532 | 797 | 79 | 75 | 61 | 370 | 4,992 |
| 2018 | 1,398 | 1,309 | 686 | 482 | 574 | 92 | 66 | 58 | 306 | 4,971 |
| 2019 | 1,210 | 1,216 | 635 | 429 | 275 | 48 | 37 | 28 | 178 | 4,056 |
| 2020 | 979 | 824 | 455 | 353 | 260 | 17 | 7 | 7 | 68 | 2,970 |
| 2021 | 1,003 | 740 | 490 | 475 | 131 | 28 | 10 | 13 | 46 | 2,936 |
| 2022 | 990 | 676 | 440 | 572 | 128 | 20 | 9 | 10 | 20 | 2,865 |
| 2023 | 940 | 681 | 254 | 516 | 174 | 10 | 1 | 0 | 17 | 2,593 |
| 2024 | 519 | 534 | 116 | 262 | 83 | 4 | 1 | 0 | 16 | 1,535 |
| 2025 | 12 | 245 | 46 | 75 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 381 |

Totals for the period by office: EP 9,391, WO 8,508, US 4,610, CN 4,234, DE 3,329, KR 400, CA 260, BR 256, JP 254, ES 240, RU 238.

Things to keep in mind when reading this:

- **Publication lag.** Applications publish about 18 months after filing, so 2024 and 2025 are incomplete. The drop in those years is not a real decline.
- **Real structural decline 2016 to 2020.** The fall from about 5,200 to about 3,000 per year is genuine and coincides with the spin-offs of Siemens Healthineers, Siemens Energy and Siemens Mobility. Those entities file under their own names and are excluded here.
- **Scope is Siemens AG only.** The harmonized name cluster covers SIEMENS, SIEMENS AKTIENGESELLSCHAFT and Siemens Corporation. It excludes 188 related entities, the largest being Siemens Healthcare (8,975 applications), Siemens Mobility (6,748), Siemens Gamesa (5,055), Siemens Energy Global (5,027) and Siemens Energy (4,767). I can add any of these if you want a group-wide view.
- **Direct German filings fell sharply** from 907 in 2016 to about 130 by 2021, while EP and PCT (WO) routes held steady. Chinese filings are the one office trending up, peaking at 572 in 2022.
